notablePrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Skycoach Waypoint can tap to produce at least {8}{G}{G}.
description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {8}{G}{G}.
Activate Skycoach Waypoint's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, causing Emeritus of Abundance to become prepared.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rude Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
